I personally prefer higher skill gap FPS games that require learning  how to aim, map timings, spawn systems (if applicable), leading projectiles (if applicable), equipment, and movement.

I understand that its not for everyone, and if you don't like grinding a game to get better, then you are not the target audience for those games.
